items.title: Won the ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper Award at FSE 2026
items.description: "Carbon-Taxed Transformers" was recognized as a Distinguished Paper, one of the highest honors at a flagship software engineering conference.

items.title: Published at FSE 2026 (paper and poster)
items.description: Carbon-Taxed Transformers appeared as a full research paper and a poster at the ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering.

items.title: Serving as President of the USask Graduate Students' Association
items.description: Elected to represent more than 4,500 graduate students, and appointed to the University Senate and Provost Search Committee.

items.title: Received the GSA Research Excellence Award (STEM)
items.description: Recognized for outstanding research contributions in science, technology, engineering, and math at the University of Saskatchewan.

items.title: Awarded Best Thesis (MSc) in Computer Science
items.description: Honored for exceptional research during Master's studies at the University of Saskatchewan.

items.title: Won the People's Choice Best Paper Award at IWSC 2023
items.description: Paper on large language models and code clones voted best by attendees at the International Workshop on Software Clones in Bogota, Colombia.
